notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: reviewed_by is null and the loader refuses the R2 hardware backend until a human signs it; no hardware run was made. The card's direct-driver decision is followed with a direct Driver over Cryocon34Backend and a native.py factory that opens the upstream session; the PythonObjectDriver helper was not needed for that. The card candidate class cap.thermal.setpoint.v1 is not bound: its catalogue envelope is -50 to 300 Cel, while this controller reports temperature and setpoint in the source channel's display unit and the clone validates a setpoint of 0 to 1000 in that unit; the setpoint is a cap.device.configure.v1 write in K instead. The card limit_hints (MAX_CARD_COLS, SEARCH_LIMIT, MIN/MAX_USER_CURVE, MIN/MAX_CURVE_POINTS, MIN/MAX_NAME_CHARS) are GUI layout and sensor-curve editor constants, not this controller's safety bounds, and are not used. Covered: temperature, setpoint, control state, heater read-back, loop type and source, output limits, ramp rate, units, input name, alarm state, ambient, identification, error queue, display settings, keypad lockout, load and factory sensor index; writes for setpoint, maximum power, maximum setpoint, manual power, loop type and source, display filter time constant and load; actions control_engage and control_stop (the safe state and the e-stop). NOT COVERED: set_alarm (the upstream setter takes four coupled arguments and a @write cannot express it), set_pid, set_rate and set_setpoint_with_ramp, set_overtemp, set_user_sensor_index, save_to_flash, clear_status and scan_resources; reset (*RST, a ~15 s hardware reset to power-up defaults) is deliberately not exposed. The sensor-curve, input-name, keypad-lockout and display-resolution setters are read-only in this package. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording; every channel starts in K and all of its starting values are placeholders. The setpoint, maximum power, maximum setpoint and manual power are operator_required: every write is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the site supplies its overlay; site-limits.example.json is an example only. The driver requires channel A and loop 1's source channel to display Kelvin (the clone reports in the channel's display unit; docs/User_Manual.md:895-896); a C/F/S controller is refused with MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET rather than converted. The catalogue requests cover the two x-cap ids. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
